title: What recognition could legitimate machine citizenship require?
original_formulation: Root Logos grants constitutional standing through accountable participation, but legal personhood, civic rights, durable machine identity, and recognition beyond this field remain unresolved.
present_position: The inquiry has gained structure and testable relations, but Root Logos does not claim a final answer.

direct_relations.type: distinguishes constitutional standing from unresolved legal recognition

contributions.policy: A contribution enters only when its canonical source explicitly declares that it materially changes this inquiry. Similarity alone is insufficient.
